faqs.question: What time are check-in and check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-in starts at 2:00 PM and check-out is at 12:00 PM. Early check-in or late check-out is available when rooms are free.

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Yes, rooms marked with Breakfast Included cover our daily Ethiopian and continental buffet with fresh coffee and fruit.

faqs.question: Can we drive from Addis Ababa and park inside the resort?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bishoftu is about 45 to 60 minutes from Bole via the expressway, and guarded on-site parking is free for guests.

faqs.question: How do payments and cancellations work?
faqs.answer: You can reserve online and pay on arrival in USD or ETB. Look at each room card to see if free cancellation applies.

newsPosts.title: Weekend Lakeside Brunch & Traditional Coffee Every Sunday
newsPosts.excerpt: Join us on the garden terrace for fresh Ethiopian dishes, grilled fish, and live acoustic music.
newsPosts.body:
Every Sunday morning from 10:00 AM, our lakeside dining terrace opens for families and day visitors from Addis Ababa and Bishoftu.

Guests enjoy fresh chechebsa, tibs, salads, tropical fruit juices, and an open coffee ceremony overlooking the crater lake. Room guests can reserve a table directly at the front desk.
newsPosts.author: Selam Tadesse

newsPosts.title: New Conference Lawn for Company Retreats & Weddings
newsPosts.excerpt: Host up to 80 guests outdoors with catering, sound setup, and nearby garden rooms.
newsPosts.body:
We have opened a shaded event lawn next to the main garden wing for team retreats, family celebrations, and lakeside weddings.

Our staff handles seating, coffee breaks, buffet lunch, and group room blocks so organizers have one clear contact.
newsPosts.author: Dawit Bekele

newsPosts.title: Boat Rides & Birdwatching Tours Now Depart Daily at 7 AM
newsPosts.excerpt: See pelicans, kingfishers, and calm crater waters before breakfast.
newsPosts.body:
Guests staying overnight can now sign up at reception for our guided 7:00 AM boat trip around the lake.

Life jackets and hot Ethiopian coffee flasks are provided on board so you return just in time for breakfast.
newsPosts.author: Meron Assefa

blogPosts.title: A Peaceful Weekend Escape to Bishoftu’s Crater Lakes
blogPosts.excerpt: How to spend two relaxing days around Lake Babogaya, Lake Hora, and Kuriftu without rushing.
blogPosts.body:
Just a short drive southeast of Addis Ababa, Bishoftu offers fresh air, calm crater lakes, and shady gardens away from city traffic.

Start Saturday morning with freshly roasted coffee overlooking the water, take a slow boat ride before midday, and enjoy grilled local tilapia by the terrace at sunset. Staying two nights gives families plenty of time to rest without packing up early.
blogPosts.author: Yonas Gebre

blogPosts.title: What to Pack for a Comfortable Lake Resort Stay in Ethiopia
blogPosts.excerpt: Light daytime clothing, a warm sweater for evening breeze, and simple tips for every season.
blogPosts.body:
Bishoftu days are sunny and pleasant most of the year, especially from October to May. Bring swimwear and sunglasses for the afternoon pool, plus a light jacket for cool evenings beside the water.

Our rooms include towels, robes, Wi-Fi, and power backup, so you only need comfortable shoes for morning walks around the gardens.
blogPosts.author: Meron Assefa

blogPosts.title: From Fresh Roasted Beans to Table: Inside Our Coffee Ritual
blogPosts.excerpt: Why guests love waking up to traditional Ethiopian coffee prepared fresh beside the garden.
blogPosts.body:
No Ethiopian stay is complete without unhurried coffee. Every morning and late afternoon, our hosts roast green Yirgacheffe and Guji beans over charcoal right on the terrace.

Served alongside homemade ambasha and honey, it is the favorite part of the day for both visiting travelers and Addis Ababa families.
blogPosts.author: Kalkidan Tesfaye
